name: Moonlight Duelists
source:
Bao Huynh, Second Year Student, fights for the sake of fighting, tempted by a love of violence and a toxic obsession with the University's top Duelist, Janis Nightingale. Experience the unstable mind of Bao while she explores the strange school, fails at social situations, and enters a dreaming realm where she thinks she'll be free of consequences.

[From [url=https://kayinad.itch.io/moonlight-duelists]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
大學二年級學生黃寶為打鬥本身而打鬥。暴力讓她著迷，而她對校內首席決鬥者賈妮絲．南丁格爾的迷戀也早已變得病態。走進黃寶動盪不安的內心，看她探索這所古怪的學校，在社交場合屢屢碰壁，再踏入一片夢境。她以為，到了那裡，無論做什麼都不用承擔後果。

［摘自[url=https://kayinad.itch.io/moonlight-duelists]itch.io[/url]］
